simulationVersion.title: M4b proxy v1 · single capsule
simulationVersion.description: One dynamic vertical capsule per player; 3D rotation and contacts are solver-resolved.

method.numericalReproducibility: same process, same fixture, exact result signature for 4 m/s control cell
method.impulseEstimates: contact impulses use solver reporting when available; otherwise relative-velocity estimates explicitly retain multi-contact and external-force confounds
method.energy: full scenario replays store per-body kinetic/potential energy and applied-force traces; sweep outputs store events and system stability summaries

events.model: torso-anchor spring-damper with equal-and-opposite forces; no articulated arm or hand grasp
